annotations.title: Tomorrow's sun on the roof (solar roof check)

description: What the plan behind a solar roof check link will make tomorrow, from the German Weather Service forecast (Bright Sky): expected kWh and the peak, hour by hour, against what a clear sky would give, sunrise and sunset, and the best stretch of the day to run the dishwasher or charge the car slowly from the roof's own power (with how much of the job the roof covers then). A forecast, cached ten minutes; the plan is read from the link, nothing is stored. Takes the link from plan_roof or edit_roof.

link.description: A solar roof check link (https://pv.skysolar.de/dachcheck/#d=…), as plan_roof, edit_roof or the solar roof check page gave it.
